strategy_lineage: bootstrap robustness audit for locked screening winners F-BREADTH and F-HIGHBETA
hypothesis: At least one of the two already-preregistered screening winners has stable incremental value under paired 63-session circular moving-block bootstrap rather than a chance full-history advantage.
allowed_changes: statistical resampling only on the exact already-recorded F-BREADTH, F-HIGHBETA, matched-control and V11 portfolio CSVs
mechanical application of the frozen bootstrap robustness gates
forbidden_changes: any factor rule, source, lookback, stale tolerance, retention fraction or rebalance band change
any new strategy rerun or portfolio reconstruction
subperiod-only rescue bootstrap after viewing full-history results
selection_metric: No winner optimization. Independently bootstrap-certify or reject both locked screening winners using the same frozen method and gates.
follow_up_policy: No method or gate rescue is allowed. A BOOTSTRAP_ROBUST_PASS may proceed only to a separately preregistered execution/latency stress. A failure preserves the earlier screening PASS but forbids robust-certified wording.
swift_engine_entrypoint: No new strategy simulation. scripts/run_screening_factor_bootstrap_robustness.py consumes immutable Swift-engine portfolio outputs from ATM-SVP2-ORTHO-FACTOR-003 and -004.
expected_outputs: observed aligned sample metadata for each locked candidate
20000 paired circular moving-block bootstrap replicates per locked candidate
probability candidate Sharpe exceeds matched control
mechanical BOOTSTRAP_ROBUST_PASS/FAIL for both locked candidates
run authorization receipt, execution Git commit and SHA-256 artifact manifests

bootstrap.sampling: paired circular moving blocks; identical sampled indices for candidate, matched control and V11 within each replicate
